fields.title: Inception
fields.synopsis: A skilled thief who steals secrets through dream-sharing technology is offered a chance to erase his past by performing an unusually difficult act: planting an idea in a target's mind.

fields.title: The Grand Adventure
fields.synopsis: A group of friends follows an old map across several towns while learning that the journey matters as much as the destination.

fields.title: Midnight Signal
fields.synopsis: A student discovers a mysterious radio signal that appears every midnight and begins investigating where it comes from.

fields.title: Second Chances
fields.synopsis: After returning to a familiar hometown, a young professional reconnects with old friends and decides what kind of future to build.

fields.title: The Last Horizon
fields.synopsis: An exploration crew reaches a distant world and must work together when their planned route home becomes impossible.
